742 people rated Bánh Mì & You 4.8 stars. On a bánh mì spot. In Phu Quoc.

That's not an accident. That's a sandwich worth finding.

Sit-down vibes, fresh ingredients, and a menu that goes way beyond the standard street version. Budget around $15-30 per person and walk out full.

Bánh Mì & You is at Cửa Lấp, away from the main tourist strip. Which means shorter queues and better food.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
